item.title: Antofagasta profit and dividend surge, but production falls
item.summary: Antofagasta reported a sharp rise in first-half earnings and lifted its dividend by more than 80%, as soaring copper prices more than made up for a dip in production at the Chilean miner. Revenue rose 18% to $4.48bn in the six months to 30 June, driven by a 36% jump in the average realised copper […] The post Antofagasta profit and dividend surge, but production falls appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
